## Survey Flow

```{r fig.align="center", out.width="80%", echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

library(DiagrammeR)

grViz("
digraph survey_flow {
  graph [layout = dot, rankdir = TB]

  node [shape = box, style = filled, fontname = Helvetica, fontsize = 20, width=2.5, fixedsize=false]

  # Main vertical flow
  Consent -> SSVS -> General_Instructions -> Quiz -> Final_Instructions -> Randomizer1 -> AttentionCheck -> Randomizer2 -> Debrief -> Prolific3

  # Exit paths (horizontal, off to the side)
  Consent -> Prolific1 [label = \"No Consent\", fontsize = 20, constraint=false]
  Quiz -> Prolific2 [label = \"  < 2 out of 3\", fontsize = 20, constraint=false]


  # Align exit nodes horizontally
  { rank = same; Prolific1 Prolific2 Prolific3}

  # Node colors
  Consent [fillcolor = gainsboro]
  SSVS [fillcolor = lightblue]
  General_Instructions [label = \"General Instructions\", fillcolor = gainsboro]
  Quiz [label = \"Comprehension Quiz\", fillcolor = gainsboro]
  Final_Instructions [label = \"Final Instructions\", fillcolor = gainsboro]
  Randomizer1 [label = \"Randomizer:\\n 7 Items\", fillcolor = thistle1]
  Randomizer2 [label = \"Randomizer:\\n 7 Items\", fillcolor = thistle1]
  AttentionCheck [fillcolor = gainsboro]
  Debrief [fillcolor = gainsboro]
  Prolific1 [label = \"Prolific:\\n No Consent\", fillcolor = mistyrose]
  Prolific2 [label = \"Prolific:\\n Failed Quiz\", fillcolor = mistyrose]
  Prolific3 [label = \"Prolific:\\n End of Survey\", fillcolor = mistyrose]
}
")
```
